stemMarkdown: In a class, 20 boys have an average score of 50 and 10 girls have an average score of 46. What is the average score of the whole class? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total score $= 20 \times 50 + 10 \times 46 = 1460$ across $30$ students, so the average is $\dfrac{1460}{30} = 48.67$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The combined average must lie between 46 and 50, closer to whichever group is larger — a useful sanity check before computing.
